title: From Fear to Laughter
logline: After being mugged on his way to a friend's house, a Grade 9 boy finds healing and laughter when he calls his best friend to share the wild story.

audience.who: Families and close friends who share unforgettable childhood memories
audience.where: Family group chats and social video feeds
audience.feel: A warm sense of relief, resilience, and the joy of true friendship
